notes: True homograph of the existing H7686 ("go astray; reel"), distinguished by sin vs. shin (both render bare as שגה) -- added as שגה¹ per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H7686 is retroactively renamed שגה² in this same batch.

Hiphil ("increase; grow great", Ps.73.12, הִשְׂגּוּ, "these are the ungodly... they increase in riches") is attested but wasn't part of the original request -- added per the full-stem-coverage check; same sense as the requested qal.
